highlights: 10% cashback on supermarkets, retail, local purchases, contactless payments, and transport, with 8% cashback on FCY spending. You can also earn up to 8% cashback on dining and 0.3% on other purchases. Note that all cashback is capped at S$25, and a minimum spend of S$800 is required. Cashback capped at S$100 per month.

extra.description: Designed for the young and the bold, the OCBC Frank Cards offers a spectrum of exclusive benefits, from up to 10% cashback on lifestyle essentials to personalised designs that mirror your unique style. Embrace a card that celebrates your individuality while empowering your financial journey.
